audience: recruiters and hiring managers who run job requisitions in SmartRecruiters

useCases.title: Track open jobs and their candidates
useCases.text: Search open job requisitions, read one job, then search the candidates who applied to it.

useCases.title: Review one candidate's application
useCases.text: Read a candidate's profile, then their application to one job, with status and screening answers.

useCases.title: Tag candidates for a shortlist
useCases.text: Add tags to one candidate. Existing tags stay, because the call never replaces or removes tags.

useCases.title: Check recruiters and job offers
useCases.text: List the company users with their system roles. Search job offers if your key's user has the Extended or Admin role.
